headline: Blockades Reported Across Mexico as Truckers Protest Insecurity and Fees
summary: National trucking associations reported blockades in Oaxaca, central Mexico, and Veracruz, warning that an indefinite strike involving up to 1 million trucks could disrupt goods and fuel supplies.
why: Logistics strikes and highway blockades can severely disrupt supply chains, raising transportation costs and causing inventory delays for manufacturers and retailers operating in the region.

impacts.name: Transportation and Logistics
impacts.why: Nationwide blockades and potential strikes disrupt supply chains and movement of fuel and goods.

why_moved: Widespread blockades halt freight transit, creating severe supply bottlenecks that threaten retail and fuel distribution networks across Mexico.
